llm.summary: This is a coherent real-estate skill generator, but some optional templates steer agents into customer, owner, and channel data management without enough consent, retention, or activation safeguards.

dimensions.detail: The reviewed artifact is mostly instruction templates plus a local renderer and mock adapter. The mock adapter has no external API calls and uses declared fake data; real deployments are expected to provide custom adapters, so users must review those separately.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The installer is explicit and user-run: it copies a rendered skill directory into a detected or specified agent skills directory and records a SHA-256 hash. This changes agent behavior but is disclosed and requires a generated SKILL.md plus manifest.json.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Generated skill descriptions trigger on configurable keyword mentions, and the sample configurations include broad real-estate terms. The templates add some gating around tool use and sales conversion, but activation criteria are still under-scoped for a sales/CRM context.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Several optional modules instruct agents to create and update customer files, listing files, sensitive owner notes, read-receipt tracking, and operational records. Some privacy limits are present, but consent, retention, deletion, and access-control requirements are not consistently specified.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The package purpose is clear: generate Chinese real-estate advisor skills for buyers, developers, brokerages, and channel distributors. Sales conversion, adapter-based property data lookup, CRM support, listing audits, and channel workflows fit that purpose, but they involve sensitive business and personal data.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review generated brand.yaml triggers before installing, especially for developer-sales or CRM use. Use explicit brand/project/city phrases, require user confirmation before lead capture or contact sharing, and only connect adapters that enforce authorization, minimization, retention, deletion, and access controls for customer, owner, and partner data.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad trigger concern is supported by the sample trigger_keywords and archetype descriptions. This is not hidden or malicious, but it is a real scoping issue because generic housing terms can invoke sales-oriented generated skills.
[SQP-2] expected: The CRM, listing-audit, and channel-management data flows are expected for real-estate business workflows and are disclosed in the templates. The finding remains relevant because optional modules collect or track sensitive customer, owner, and partner information with incomplete consent, retention, and access-control guidance.
